overview: Still at the board, you restored the three breaths. York runs short, Gaunt runs long, and the King never runs out. The sheet is cleaner for what you removed. You wrote on the tables that not all of them may sing, and you wrote nothing under the line.

parties.name: William Shakespeare
parties.context: Restored the three breaths and wrote the line.

assets.name: Richard II
assets.disposition: Gave the uncles their breaths back

summary: Gave the uncles their breaths back
